texts.title: Public signs
texts.instructions: Look at the text in each question. What does it say? Choose the correct letter A, B or C.

options: You can park here for free
questions.explanation: No parking means it is forbidden to park.

options: The shop closes at 2 PM only
The shop is closed at 1 PM
The shop is open at 1 PM
questions.explanation: Between 12 and 2 PM the shop is closed. At 1 PM it is closed.

questions.sign: PLEASE DO NOT FEED THE ANIMALS
options: Feeding is allowed only at night
You must not feed the animals
questions.explanation: Do not feed means it is prohibited.

texts.title: An email from a friend
texts.instructions: Read the email and answer the questions. Choose A, B or C.
texts.text: Hi Sarah, How are you? I am writing to tell you about my weekend. On Saturday I went to the cinema with my brother. We saw a comedy and it was very funny. On Sunday it was my mother birthday, so we had lunch in a nice restaurant near the park. The food was delicious! Next weekend I am going to visit my grandparents in the countryside. I will take some photos and send them to you. Write back soon! Love, Emma

questions.question: What did Emma do on Saturday?
options: She had lunch in a restaurant
questions.explanation: The email says: On Saturday I went to the cinema with my brother.

questions.question: Why did the family go to a restaurant on Sunday?
options: They did not want to cook
questions.explanation: The email says: On Sunday it was my mother birthday, so we had lunch in a nice restaurant.

questions.question: What is Emma going to do next weekend?
questions.explanation: The email says: Next weekend I am going to visit my grandparents.

texts.title: A notice at school
texts.instructions: Read the notice and answer the questions. Choose A, B or C.
texts.text: SCHOOL TRIP TO LONDON - Saturday 15th May. The bus leaves at 8:00 AM from the school entrance. Please arrive 15 minutes early. Bring a packed lunch and wear comfortable shoes. The trip costs 15 pounds. Pay at the school office before Wednesday. If you have any questions, speak to Mr. Brown in room 12.

questions.question: What time does the bus leave?
questions.explanation: The notice says: The bus leaves at 8:00 AM.

questions.question: What should students bring?
questions.explanation: The notice says: Bring a packed lunch.

questions.question: When should students pay?
questions.explanation: The notice says: Pay at the school office before Wednesday.

texts.title: An email about holidays
texts.instructions: Read the email and answer the questions. Choose A, B or C.
texts.text:
Hi Emma,

How are you? I am on holiday in Spain with my family. The weather is sunny and hot. Yesterday, we went to the beach. I swam in the sea and my brother built a big sandcastle. In the evening, we ate paella at a restaurant. It was delicious!

Tomorrow, we are going to visit a castle in the mountains. I will take lots of photos.

See you soon,
Lucy

questions.question: Where is Lucy on holiday?
questions.explanation: The email says 'I am on holiday in Spain with my family.'

questions.question: What did Lucy do yesterday?
questions.explanation: The email says 'Yesterday, we went to the beach. I swam in the sea.'

questions.question: What are they going to do tomorrow?
questions.explanation: The email says 'Tomorrow, we are going to visit a castle in the mountains.'

texts.title: A letter about a new school
texts.instructions: Read the letter and answer the questions. Choose A, B or C.
texts.text:
Dear Tom,

I started my new school last week. It is very big and I was nervous on the first day. My teacher, Mr. Jones, is very friendly. I have made two friends, Jack and Sarah. We play football at break time.

My favourite subject is science. We do experiments in the laboratory. I also like art, but I am not very good at drawing.

Write back soon,
Ben

questions.question: When did Ben start his new school?
questions.explanation: The letter says 'I started my new school last week.'

questions.question: What is Ben's favourite subject?
questions.explanation: The letter says 'My favourite subject is science.'

questions.question: What does Ben do at break time?
questions.explanation: The letter says 'We play football at break time.'

texts.title: An email about shopping
texts.instructions: Read the email and answer the questions. Choose A, B or C.
texts.text:
Hi Mum,

I am at the shopping centre with Kate. I want to buy a new jacket for winter. I saw a blue one in the shop window, but it was too expensive. Then I found a red one for £30. It is cheaper and I like the colour.

Kate bought a pair of shoes. They were on sale. We are going to have lunch at the café now.

See you later,
Anna

questions.question: What does Anna want to buy?
questions.explanation: The email says 'I want to buy a new jacket for winter.'

questions.question: Why didn't Anna buy the blue jacket?
questions.explanation: The email says 'I saw a blue one in the shop window, but it was too expensive.'

questions.question: What did Kate buy?
questions.explanation: The email says 'Kate bought a pair of shoes.'
